pages.title: Entanglement Links
pages.text: $(thing)Entanglement Links$()$(br2)Two photons from one source stay one system however far apart they go. A store of such pairs, split between two places, makes one channel. Unlocks the Entangled Link and an early Entanglement Tuner.

$(thing)Insight$(): 40$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Quantum Entanglement.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Entangled Photon Pair.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Two entangled particles are measured at two settings each, and four correlations A, B, C and D are found, one for each pair of settings. Write the sum S whose size tells a quantum channel from any classical one (it can reach 2√2; nothing classical passes 2). The second correlation enters with a minus sign.
